name: loopd-mod-usage
displayName: loopd — usage (a mod that records what a session spent)
description: COMPANION, a mod. Records each session's token usage, request count, tool calls by name, tool errors, wall time and model in the plugin store under loopd.usage.<session id>; core's session-usage.sh reads that record before it falls back to the transcript. Observes only: no model call, no permission decision, no process, no network, no file. Not installed = session-usage.sh reads the transcript as before.
